propositions: A single test in test_wiki_render_hardening.py walks all 884 renderable units in one function (1768 pandoc spawns), taking 91.6s idle and 504.8s under contention — 1.7x past the 300s per-test budget.
CI's --timeout-method=thread fires os._exit(1) from a timer thread when the budget is exceeded, killing the xdist worker outright with no traceback instead of failing the test.
The test failure is reproducible on the macOS py3.13 cell by running pytest with --timeout=20 --timeout-method=thread, emitting 'node down: Not properly terminated' and worker crash.
The fix chunks the equivalence test into fixed-size batches (EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK=40) via parametrize, so per-test cost is bounded and independent of corpus size.
A new coverage guard test asserts all chunks reassemble to the full unit list (884 units, >= 100 total) to prevent silent unit drops.
All 884 units remain compared against the oracle with real pandoc (EQUIVALENCE_STRIDE=1), and the byte-identity property is untouched by chunking.
